title: JSON Data Processing
description: Serialize a Python dictionary to JSON, then parse it back and read a value.
code:
import json

data = {"name": "Asha", "age": 21, "skills": ["Python", "SQL"]}

json_text = json.dumps(data)
print("Serialized:", json_text)

parsed = json.loads(json_text)
print("Name:", parsed["name"])
print("First skill:", parsed["skills"][0])
